summary.text: Kimberly Pope Adams is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 82nd District, which covers part of Dinwiddie County, part of Prince George County, Surry County and the city of Petersburg, and has served since January 14, 2026.
Adams sits on the House committees on Finance; Agriculture, Chesapeake and Natural Resources; and Transportation.

paragraphs.text: Kimberly Pope Adams was born in Hopewell, VA, according to the House profile.
The profile lists Adams's education as Virginia Tech (Bachelor of Science in Accounting & Information Systems, 2005) and Liberty University Online (Master of Business Administration, 2017).
The profile gives Adams's occupation as accountant/auditor.

Adams's listed memberships and affiliations include Dinwiddie Democratic Committee (First Vice-Chair); Petersburg Democratic Committee; Prince George Democratic Committee; Surry County Democratic Committee; NAACP (Dinwiddie Branch).
